3247	// redactFinalizedTranscript redacts the finalized full-session transcript,
3248	// delegating to redactSessionTranscript so finalize and post-commit condensation
3249	// share one pipeline. That sharing is load-bearing, not tidiness: both store the
3250	// same sanitized, image-externalized bytes for the same session under the same
3251	// prefix-cache key, so a divergence between them would splice a prefix produced
3252	// by one pipeline onto a suffix produced by the other. Going through the same
3253	// function -- including its injectable redactSessionJSONLBytes seam -- makes that
3254	// impossible rather than merely unlikely.
3255	//
3256	// ok=false means abandon this finalize pass, and is returned only for a degraded
3257	// scanner -- the caller keeps TurnCheckpointIDs so a repeated Stop process can
3258	// retry, since the degradation flag is per-process. Any other redaction failure
3259	// drops the transcript and returns ok=true, preserving the rest of the checkpoint
3260	// metadata: hooks have no retry path, and partial metadata beats none.
3261	func redactFinalizedTranscript(
3262		logCtx context.Context,
3263		repo *git.Repository,
3264		sessionID string,
3265		fullTranscript []byte,
3266	) (transcript redact.RedactedBytes, ok bool) {
3267		redacted, _, err := redactSessionTranscript(logCtx, repo, sessionID, fullTranscript)
3268		if err == nil {
3269			return redacted, true
3270		}
3271	
3272		if errors.Is(err, redact.ErrScannerDegraded) {
3273			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: transcript redaction degraded, skipping",
3274				slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
3275				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
3276			)
3277			return redact.RedactedBytes{}, false
3278		}
3279	
3280		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: transcript redaction failed, dropping transcript",
3281			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
3282			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
3283		)
3284		return redact.RedactedBytes{}, true
3285	}

3287	// finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints replaces the provisional transcript in each checkpoint
3288	// created during this turn with the full session transcript.
3289	//
3290	// This is called at turn end (stop hook). During the turn, PostCommit wrote whatever
3291	// transcript was available at commit time. Now we have the complete transcript and
3292	// replace it so every checkpoint has the full prompt-to-stop context.
3293	//
3294	// deadline bounds only the store open and the checkpoint writes, the steps
3295	// that can wait on a slow remote; the zero time means no deadline.
3296	//
3297	// Returns the number of errors encountered (best-effort: continues processing on error).
3298	// Checkpoints the deadline or a cancellation cut off are not counted: the
3299	// interruption is logged and recorded as capture degradation instead.
3300	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, state *SessionState, deadline time.Time) int {
3301		if len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs) == 0 {
3302			return 0 // No mid-turn commits to finalize
3303		}
3304	
3305		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint")
3306	
3307		logging.Info(logCtx, "finalizing turn checkpoints with full transcript",
3308			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3309			slog.Int("checkpoint_count", len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs)),
3310		)
3311	
3312		if ctx.Err() != nil {
3313			abandonInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, ctx.Err())
3314			return 0
3315		}
3316	
3317		// Read full transcript from live transcript file, re-resolving the path if the
3318		// agent relocated it mid-session (e.g., Cursor CLI flat → nested layout change).
3319		if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
3320			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: no transcript path, skipping",
3321				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3322			)
3323			state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
3324			return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
3325		}
3326	
3327		transcriptPath, resolveErr := resolveTranscriptPath(state)
3328		if resolveErr != nil {
3329			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: transcript path resolution failed, skipping",
3330				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3331				slog.Any("error", resolveErr),
3332			)
3333			state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
3334			return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
3335		}
3336	
3337		ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; ExtractSkillEvents handles nil
3338	
3339		fullTranscript, err := agent.ReadTranscriptFile(transcriptPath)
3340		if err != nil || len(fullTranscript) == 0 {
3341			// A late-transcript agent (agy) writes its transcript AFTER the Stop
3342			// hook, so an empty file here is the placeholder PrepareTranscript
3343			// materialised when the flush lost the race — a normal, transient
3344			// state, not a lost transcript. Keep TurnCheckpointIDs so a later
3345			// HandleTurnEnd in this turn finalizes with the flushed content, the
3346			// same deferral the degraded-scanner path below uses; nilling them
3347			// would abandon the backfill for every mid-turn checkpoint of the turn
3348			// on the first Stop that beat the flush.
3349			if _, late := agent.AsLateTranscriptWriter(ag); late && err == nil {
3350				logging.Info(logCtx, "finalize: late-transcript agent has not flushed yet, deferring",
3351					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3352					slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
3353					slog.Int("checkpoint_count", len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs)),
3354				)
3355				return 1 // Reported, not abandoned: TurnCheckpointIDs survive for the retry
3356			}
3357			msg := "finalize: empty transcript, skipping"
3358			if err != nil {
3359				msg = "finalize: failed to read transcript, skipping"
3360			}
3361			logging.Warn(logCtx, msg,
3362				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3363				slog.String("transcript_path", state.TranscriptPath),
3364				slog.Any("error", err),
3365			)
3366			state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
3367			return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
3368		}
3369	
3370		// Open repository (needed for the checkpoint store)
3371		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
3372		if err != nil {
3373			if ctx.Err() != nil {
3374				abandonInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, ctx.Err())

3376			}
3377			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to open repository",
3378				slog.String("error", err.Error()),

3382		}

3397	
3398		// Redact secrets before writing. Checkpoint store methods require
3399		// pre-redacted in-memory transcript content from callers. The live
3400		// transcript on disk is still treated as raw/untrusted input, so redact it
3401		// here before anything is persisted to the metadata branch.
3402		//
3403		// On failure: drop the transcript but continue writing checkpoint metadata
3404		// (files touched, prompts). Hooks run without user interaction
3405		// so there is no retry path — preserving partial metadata is better than
3406		// losing everything. Persisting an unredacted transcript would be worse.
3407		// Run the regex-only pipeline over the transcript — OPF runs later in
3408		// the pre-push rewrite path, which re-redacts these regex-only blobs
3409		// and produces OPF-applied (9-layer) commits before the push goes out.
3410		// Externalize inline images BEFORE redaction, mirroring CondenseSession, so the
3411		// finalized (authoritative, full-session) transcript keeps its placeholders and
3412		// matching assets instead of re-inlining what condensation lifted out. Opt-in;
3413		// a no-codec agent or a transcript with no images is a no-op.
3414		var finalizeAssets []checkpoint.TranscriptAsset
3415		// Whether externalization actually RAN at finalize. When it did not (flag

3417		// ENTIRE_EXTERNALIZE_IMAGES env override not inherited by the hook
3418		// process, or settings toggled mid-session), an empty finalizeAssets means

3420		// the previously-stored assets would permanently lose them (the re-inlined
3421		// base64 is destroyed by redaction below).
3422		externalizationRan := false
3423		if settings.IsImageExternalizationEnabled(ctx) {
3424			rewritten, assets, exErr := extractSessionImages(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
3425			if exErr != nil {
3426				logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: image externalization failed; leaving transcript inline",
3427					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3428					slog.String("error", exErr.Error()),
3429				)
3430			} else {
3431				fullTranscript = rewritten
3432				finalizeAssets = assets
3433				externalizationRan = true
3434			}
3435		}
3436		// Re-capture sidecar images (e.g. Cursor's SQLite store) so a finalize that
3437		// rewrites the transcript re-writes them too. When the full transcript differs
3438		// from the stored (mid-turn) one, writeAssets clears the whole assets/ folder
3439		// and re-writes only these assets — omitting the sidecar images here would drop
3440		// what CondenseSession captured. Content-hash names make this idempotent with
3441		// condensation's write; when the transcript is unchanged, writeAssets is not
3442		// called and condensation's assets are left intact.
3443		finalizeAssets = append(finalizeAssets, sidecarSessionImages(ctx, logCtx, ag, state)...)
3444		// Sidecar capture is best-effort: a transient miss here (sqlite3 locked/timed
3445		// out) yields no assets. For a sidecar-capable agent, preserve the assets a
3446		// prior condensation stored rather than letting an empty set clear them.
3447		_, sidecarCapable := agent.AsSidecarImageProvider(ag)
3448	
3449		redactedTranscript, redactOK := redactFinalizedTranscript(logCtx, repo, state.SessionID, fullTranscript)
3450		if !redactOK {
3451			return 1
3452		}
3453	
3454		// Post-commit emits regex-only blobs; the writer joins + redacts
3455		// via checkpoint.redactedJoinedPrompts. OPF runs later, once per
3456		// push, in the pre-push rewrite path.
3457		// The hook store envelope (see hookCheckpointStoreOptions): the transcript
3458		// finalize targets existing checkpoints whose refs — and, on a partial
3459		// clone, whose blobs — may live only on the remote (resumed/adopted
3460		// multi-machine sessions). This loops over every checkpoint of the turn
3461		// against one store, so both fetch paths need their own memo or a dead
3462		// network costs the budget N times: gitRefsStore.fetchFailure covers refs,
3463		// and hookBlobFetcher memoizes an exhausted blob fetch. Neither memo detects
3464		// a slow remote whose fetches succeed just under budget, so the turn-end
3465		// deadline bounds this network phase as a whole. Only this phase checks it:
3466		// the preparation above is local work, and the deadline exists to stop slow
3467		// fetches.
3468		networkCtx := ctx
3469		if !deadline.IsZero() {
3470			var cancel context.CancelFunc
3471			networkCtx, cancel = context.WithDeadline(ctx, deadline)
3472			defer cancel()
3473		}
3474		if networkCtx.Err() != nil {
3475			abandonInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, networkCtx.Err())
3476			return 0
3477		}
3478		stores, err := checkpoint.Open(networkCtx, repo, s.hookCheckpointStoreOptions(networkCtx))
3479		if err != nil {
3480			if networkCtx.Err() != nil {
3481				abandonInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, networkCtx.Err())
3482				return 0
3483			}
3484			logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to open checkpoint store",
3485				slog.String("error", err.Error()),
3486			)
3487			return 1 // Count as error - all checkpoints will be skipped
3488		}
3489		// The deadline can pass while Open runs; precompute would then hash the
3490		// whole transcript for writes that never start.
3491		if networkCtx.Err() != nil {
3492			abandonInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, networkCtx.Err())
3493			return 0
3494		}
3495		store := stores.Persistent
3496	
3497		precomputed := precomputeTranscriptBlobsForFinalize(logCtx, repo, redactedTranscript, state)
3498	
3499		updateOpts := checkpoint.UpdateOptions{
3500			SessionID:               state.SessionID,
3501			Transcript:              redactedTranscript,
3502			Assets:                  finalizeAssets,
3503			PreserveAssetsWhenEmpty: sidecarCapable || !externalizationRan,
3504			Prompts:                 prompts,
3505			Agent:                   state.AgentType,
3506			SkillEvents:             skillEvents,
3507			PrecomputedBlobs:        precomputed,
3508		}
3509		errCount, interrupted := finalizeTurnCheckpointWrites(networkCtx, logCtx, store, state, updateOpts)
3510		if interrupted > 0 {
3511			recordInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, interrupted, networkCtx.Err())
3512		}
3513	
3514		// Clear turn checkpoint IDs. Do NOT update CheckpointTranscriptStart here — it was
3515		// already set correctly by PostCommit: condenseAndUpdateState sets it to the total
3516		// transcript lines when condensing, and carryForwardRemainingFiles resets it to 0
3517		// when carry-forward is active. Overwriting here would break carry-forward by making
3518		// sessionHasNewContent think the transcript is fully consumed (no growth).
3519		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
3520	
3521		return errCount
3522	}

3524	func finalizeTurnCheckpointWrites(
3525		ctx context.Context,
3526		logCtx context.Context,
3527		store checkpoint.PersistentStore,
3528		state *SessionState,
3529		updateOpts checkpoint.UpdateOptions,
3530	) (errCount, interrupted int) {
3531		for checkpointIndex, cpIDStr := range state.TurnCheckpointIDs {
3532			if ctx.Err() != nil {
3533				return errCount, len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs) - checkpointIndex
3534			}
3535	
3536			cpID, err := id.NewCheckpointID(cpIDStr)
3537			if err != nil {
3538				logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: invalid checkpoint ID, skipping",
3539					slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
3540					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
3541				)
3542				errCount++
3543				continue
3544			}
3545	
3546			updateOpts.CheckpointID = cpID
3547			if err := store.Write(ctx, checkpoint.SessionTranscript(updateOpts)); err != nil {
3548				if ctx.Err() != nil {
3549					// Counted as an interruption, but the write may have failed for
3550					// another reason as the deadline passed; keep that error visible.
3551					logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: checkpoint write failed as the context ended",
3552						slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
3553						slog.String("error", err.Error()),
3554					)
3555					return errCount, len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs) - checkpointIndex
3556				}
3557				logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: failed to update checkpoint",
3558					slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
3559					slog.String("error", err.Error()),
3560				)
3561				errCount++
3562				continue
3563			}
3564	
3565			logging.Info(logCtx, "finalize: checkpoint updated with full transcript",
3566				slog.String("checkpoint_id", cpIDStr),
3567				slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3568			)
3569		}
3570		return errCount, 0
3571	}
3572	
3573	// abandonInterruptedFinalize gives up on every remaining turn checkpoint after
3574	// the context ended before the writes began. Turn start clears the IDs anyway,
3575	// so the checkpoints keep their provisional transcripts for good; the
3576	// capture-degraded marker is what makes that visible.
3577	func abandonInterruptedFinalize(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState, cause error) {
3578		unfinalized := len(state.TurnCheckpointIDs)
3579		state.TurnCheckpointIDs = nil
3580		recordInterruptedFinalize(logCtx, state, unfinalized, cause)
3581	}
3582	
3583	// recordInterruptedFinalize marks the turn's capture as degraded. It covers a
3584	// host cancelling the hook (SIGTERM ends the root context) as well as the
3585	// turn-end deadline, since both leave checkpoints provisional.
3586	func recordInterruptedFinalize(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState, unfinalized int, cause error) {
3587		now := time.Now().UTC()
3588		state.CaptureDegradedAt = &now
3589		logging.Warn(logCtx, "finalize: interrupted; checkpoints left with provisional transcripts",
3590			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
3591			slog.Int("unfinalized_count", unfinalized),
3592			slog.Any("cause", cause),
3593		)
3594	}

docs/development/checkpoint-implementation.md:63:- **Session-end hooks that run under a host deadline** - an agent whose session-end hook fires inside its own shutdown may be killed part-way through. Such agents declare `agent.SessionEndBudgeter` (Codex: 3s cap, process tree killed on expiry). The budget bounds **only** the eager condense in `endSessionNow`, so the cheap step that un-sticks the session is never the one given up on; it is set below the host cap with enough headroom for the shell wrapper and binary load, which happen before Entire's own clock starts. Unbounded is not the same as guaranteed, though: mark-ended runs under `MutateSessionState`, whose flock acquire blocks, so a concurrent condense holding the lock can push it past the cap and get the tree killed — the exited-owner sweep above is the backstop. The bound is best-effort (condensation doesn't poll ctx between stages), and being cut off costs duplication rather than data: an incomplete condense leaves `FullyCondensed` false and PostCommit retries, except in the window between the v1 checkpoint write and the state save, where the checkpoint is already committed and PostCommit mints a second one over the same transcript range.
docs/development/checkpoint-implementation.md:64:- **Turn-end finalize runs under the turn-end hook's deadline.** `finalizeAllTurnCheckpoints` rewrites every checkpoint of the turn, and each rewrite can fetch from the remote. The per-fetch memos catch a dead network but not a slow one, so the store open and the write loop run under a deadline of `processStart` plus the agent's `agent.TurnEndBudgeter` budget (`agent.TurnEndBudgetWithin` the hook timeout the agent declares or its host applies; built-in agents that declare none get `defaultTurnEndHookTimeout` and must be listed in `turnEndBudgetFallbacks` with their reason (`TestTurnEndBudgetLedger`); external agents always take the default). Only the network phase checks the deadline: transcript preparation and redaction are local and never interrupted, though their time counts against the budget. Cut-off checkpoints are reported once, as capture degradation, not also as finalize errors. Checkpoints the deadline or a host cancellation cuts off keep their provisional transcripts for good (turn start clears `TurnCheckpointIDs`), and `CaptureDegradedAt` makes that visible in `entire status`. The late-transcript and degraded-scanner exits run before the network phase, so they keep their IDs for a repeated Stop regardless of the deadline.
